text: Какой предел по времени для груза, вынесенного из камеры к доку перед погрузкой?
note: Denial: not longer than 20 minutes outside a chamber, then back in. Traps: 15-minute warning, 45 minutes in the dry-goods warehouse, the audit report request.

spans.quote: Не дольше 20 минут вне камеры, потом паллета возвращается обратно в камеру.
A pallet must not stay in the dispatch buffer outside a chamber for longer than 20 minutes; after that it goes back into the chamber and the load is re-planned.

text: Is voice picking part of the initial release or not?
note: Only if the chamber 4 pilot reaches 98% accuracy by 20 Feb; otherwise phase two. Trap: tender 95%; the steering only says figures come next week. Answer buried in a long status.

spans.quote: Voice picking makes it into release one only if the chamber 4 pilot reaches 98% pick accuracy by 20 February; if it doesn't, it moves to phase two and the chilled team stays on scanners at go-live.

text: Ирина подтвердила, когда и сколько часов будут идти занятия у кладовщиков?
note: No: Irina approved only the module structure, not dates or hours. Trap: Fergus claims the plan was approved and sessions start 2 Feb.

spans.quote: По плану обучения от Fergus: утверждаю только структуру — шесть модулей в том порядке, как он предложил. Расписание и часы занятий не утверждаю: в феврале смены на Северном перекрыты инвентаризацией, Олег до пятницы даст окна, и после этого Fergus присылает новый график.

text: Will the fast-moving stock at North be moved closer to the doors before launch?
note: Declan's ABC re-slotting proposal was deferred again and again (later, after inventory, maybe summer); never decided.

text: Как часто будем пересчитывать остатки в морозильной зоне после запуска?
note: Spec: monthly for frozen and chilled; Marat: weekly in frozen at Riverside. Nobody decided. Trap: weekly for high-value SKUs in the spec.

text: What's the annual licence cost for the warehouse system?
note: Never stated; the spec points to a commercial annex. Traps: training budget 18,400 EUR, printer lease terms.

text: Какой размер этикетки на паллеты просил Ким с Северного?
note: Two Kims: foreman Kim Tagirov wants 100x150 mm with the cell number on top; integrator PM Kim Ashworth suggests 58 mm rolls for picking labels.

spans.quote: На паллеты нужна этикетка 100 на 150 мм: номер ячейки крупно сверху, штрихкод SSCC снизу — иначе с погрузчика с трёх метров не читается.

text: Which handheld terminals are the pickers getting?
note: Brennick C40 decided (and in the spec), replaced by Veltrax VX9 Cold in a long IT status that is not a reply. old=brennick-old new=brennick-cancel.

spans.quote: The order of 46 units went to Veltrax yesterday — model VX9 Cold, delivery 9 March, and our existing cradle positions fit them.

text: Откуда WMS будет брать температуру по камерам?
note: Cloud API of Coldsense every 15 min was decided; implicitly replaced ("идём напрямую") by Tessaro gateways over Modbus every minute. Not a reply.

spans.quote: Идём напрямую: ставим шлюзы Tessaro в каждом холодильном блоке, логгеры опрашиваем по Modbus раз в минуту, и данные сразу пишутся в базу склада.

text: Which of the two sites switches over to the new WMS first?
note: Plan Kestrel: North first on 2 March; native reply from Irina: Riverside first, 16 March.

text: Сколько недель старая и новая система будут работать параллельно?
note: Two weeks of dual entry agreed in chat and in the spec; at the steering Declan says the legacy system goes read-only at cutover, no dual entry. Meeting turn, not a reply.

spans.quote: On Vectis: at midnight of the cutover it becomes read-only, and that's it — no double keying for two weeks like in the January notes.

text: Are the label printers owned by us or leased?
note: Leased from Orvane for 24 months, nine units. Later: Orvane technician visit (does not change it). Trap: purchase 8% cheaper over three years.

spans.quote: Принтеры этикеток берём в лизинг у Orvane на 24 месяца, девять штук, покупку не делаем — Ирина вчера так решила, сервис и головки входят в платёж.

text: Сколько минут даётся перевозчику на разгрузку по записи?
note: 30 minutes for all trucks. Later: Dockhub invoice and outage messages. Traps: carriers asked 45, old practice 40.

spans.quote: Решили по записи машин: в Dockhub окно на разгрузку 30 минут, одинаково для фур и для газелей.

text: How many pallet locations does Riverside have in the new system?

spans.quote: In the new system Riverside is set up with 4,860 pallet positions: the legacy count of 5,100 included 240 locations that have been blocked since the roof repair and will not be migrated.
